szoveg_eredeti:
Hugging Face is coming to Doha, Qatar 🇶🇦

In collaboration with Qai , we're organizing a big hackathon from 05-07 November in Doha. We want to foster the spirit of open source and how it can be utilized to solve regional problems. Aritra , Younes , Serge , and I will be there to support this initiative.

Through this initiative, Qai aims to support the development of AI talent in Qatar, encourage hands-on innovation and strengthen the capabilities needed to turn AI technologies into real-world applications.

Applications close on 29 October. Places are limited and participation is subject to selection.

Don't keep calm 🔥
